annotation.title_clean: Advisory Guidelines on Use of Personal Data in Generative AI
annotation.title_en: Advisory Guidelines on Use of Personal Data in Generative AI
named_instruments_referenced: PDPC Advisory Guidelines on Use of Personal Data in AI Recommendation and Decision Systems
PDPC Advisory Guidelines on Key Concepts in the PDPA
annotation.summary_en: Singapore PDPC advisory guidelines explaining how the PDPA applies to generative AI across development, deployment and post-deployment. They cover the publicly available exception for web-scraping, consent and notification, roles of model providers, system providers and deployers, and access and correction requests. Non-binding.
key_provisions_or_claims: Organisations may rely on the Publicly Available Exception for unrestricted web data, but must assess data behind digital barriers.
Consent and AI-specific notification are required for using user data to develop models; consent cannot be a condition of service beyond what is reasonable.
Anonymisation and data minimisation are encouraged in model development.
Responsibilities are allocated among model providers, system providers and deployers.
Organisations should handle access and correction requests, including data provenance and output filters.
